Rust JavaScript package manager

Usage: jsm [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  init             
  add              
  install          
  remove           
  run              
  exec             
  list             
  why              
  config           
  store            
  versions         
  doctor           
  lock             
  completion       
  help             
  capabilities     
  x                
  serve            
  cache            
  ui               
  node             
  workspaces       
  approve-scripts  
  patch            
  patch-commit     
  migrate          
  audit            
  deploy           
  update           
  outdated         
  diff             
  dupes            
  unused           
  history          
  undo             
  redo             
  snapshot         
  switch           

Options:
      --cwd <CWD>              [default: .]
      --json                   
      --quiet                  
      --verbose                
      --offline                
      --prefer-offline         
      --prefer-store           
      --store-dir <STORE_DIR>  
      --registry <REGISTRY>    
      --no-color               
      --non-interactive        
      --progress <PROGRESS>    [default: auto] [possible values: auto, ndjson]
      --config <CONFIG>        
      --trace <FILE>           Write a Chrome trace for diagnostic runs
  -h, --help                   Print help
  -V, --version                Print version
